documents.title: 7+5 forecast below budget — Germany is the largest gap
documents.source_ref: SDP Revenue Planning — connections × ARPU by segment
documents.excerpt: The 7+5 forecast combines April–October actuals with the Snowflake ML forecast for November–March. Germany carries the largest gap to budget, while VodafoneThree and Türkiye run ahead.

documents.title: ML forecast retrained after the October close
documents.source_ref: Snowflake ML FORECAST — segment revenue series
documents.excerpt: SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST was retrained on 31 months of segment revenue after the October close; the model proposes the November–March outlook with prediction intervals for planners to accept or override.

documents.title: Snowbots closed October overnight
documents.source_ref: SDP Autopilot — Close Sentinel, Variance Explainer, Rolling Forecast
documents.excerpt: By 07:00 the Snowbots had reconciled the October SAP close, drafted the variance commentary and rolled the forecast; three approvals are waiting in the inbox.

documents.title: Energy and network inflation is the largest margin swing
documents.source_ref: SDP Scenario Analysis — base growth × ARPU × efficiency × energy
documents.excerpt: In the scenario model, energy and network cost inflation moves operating profit more than any other lever; a price war combined with an energy spike is the downside case.

documents.title: BI-style reports run live on SAP data
documents.source_ref: SDP Reports — P&L Summary, Forecast Bridge
documents.excerpt: The P&L Summary and Forecast Bridge read the same governed tables as the forecast and the AI analyst — one set of numbers for Finance, the segments and the board.
